title: feat(v30why1): first f00/f11 shared-face miss is vertex3 at t=3
science: Mechanism behind #6444's shared-face miss. Running f00=(1,1,1,0,0) and f11=(1,1,1,1,1) independently from each of the four shared-face singletons, the first neighbourhood where f00 refuses and f11 fires is t=3, site (0,1,1), occupancy (1,0,0,1,0,1), axis type vertex3=(3,0,0) - all three axes unbalanced - and the SAME first axis type occurs on all four shared-face seeds. Histories (1,5,10) for f00
